schema.y: years this occupation was published; EVERY value array below is aligned to this list
schema.a: area indices into occ_index.areas that have at least one published row
schema.p: per-area bitmask over `y`: bit i set = OEWS published a row for that area-year. A null value where the bit is SET is suppressed or unavailable; a null where the bit is CLEAR means the occupation was simply not published there that year.
schema.j: jobs_1000 [area][year] - jobs per 1,000 jobs in that state, 3 dp, as published
schema.q: loc_quotient [area][year] - location quotient vs the nation, 2 dp, as published
schema.w: a_median [area][year] - annual median wage USD, integer
schema.tc: [[area_pos, year_pos]] wage flagged '#': AT OR ABOVE occ_index.topcode_annual for that year. A CENSORED HIGH value, not missing data.
schema.wm: [[area_pos, year_pos]] wage flagged '*': wage estimate not available. Missing.
schema.es: [[area_pos, year_pos]] employment flagged '**': estimate not released. e, j and q are all null together on these rows.
schema.us: the national row from data/oews_national.json, on its OWN year axis `y` (the national file can publish a code in years the state files do not). e = employment, w = annual median. BLS publishes no jobs_1000 / loc_quotient nationally, so neither is present. tc/wm/es are year positions, not [area, year] pairs.
schema.th: per-year published titles, present only where the title changed

meta.note: series_g00 carries the 00-0000 total and the 22 major groups; every other bundle carries the detailed occupations of one SOC major group.
